tasks.subject: Explore project context (foundry, merchant-mock, banking-frontend)
tasks.description: Inspect the foundry issuer/verifier API surface (openapi.json, docs, config), the eudipay-merchant-mock frontend structure/design, and the banking-frontend structure/design. Goal: understand what foundry endpoints the merchant (verifier flow) and bank (issuer flow) must call, and capture the visual/design language of both reference apps.

tasks.subject: Ask clarifying questions one at a time
tasks.description: Understand purpose, constraints, success criteria: demo narrative, credential types, wallet interaction model, deployment/runtime expectations, persistence, auth, testing depth.

tasks.subject: Propose 2-3 architecture approaches with trade-offs
tasks.description: Present options for repo layout (monorepo vs two apps), backend style (Next.js route handlers vs separate REST server), and foundry integration boundary. Lead with recommendation.

tasks.subject: Present design in sections, get approval per section
tasks.description: Cover architecture, components, data flow (issuance + presentation), error handling, testing. Scale each section to its complexity; confirm after each.

tasks.subject: Write and commit design doc
tasks.description: Save approved design to docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-05-payment-banking-demo-design.md and commit.

tasks.subject: Spec self-review (placeholders, consistency, scope, ambiguity)
tasks.description: Scan the written spec for TBD/TODO, internal contradictions, scope creep needing decomposition, and ambiguous requirements. Fix inline.

tasks.subject: User reviews written spec
tasks.description: Ask the user to review the committed spec file and wait for approval before planning.

tasks.subject: Transition to implementation via writing-plans skill
tasks.description: Once spec is approved, invoke superpowers:writing-plans to create the implementation plan. Do not invoke any other implementation skill.
